name: USAA Preferred Cash Rewards Visa Signature

localized_names.en: USAA Preferred Cash Rewards Visa Signature

apr.notes: 0% intro APR through the May 2028 billing cycle on balance transfers and convenience checks that post by January 31, 2027. Balance transfer, convenience check and cash advance fee is 5% of each transaction (cash advance fee waived for electronic transfers to a USAA Bank deposit account). No penalty APR is stated.

credit_required.notes: USAA membership is required to apply.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on purchases with no category restrictions.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem some or all of your cash back. Your cashback rewards never expire.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $200 reward bonus after spending $1,000 on qualifying purchases by January 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.description: Cell phone protection listed on the USAA card page; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide for terms.

benefits.title: Extended warranty protection
benefits.description: Extended warranty protection listed on the USAA card page; see the Credit Card Benefits Guide for terms.

notes: If you apply for a USAA Visa Signature Credit Card and are approved for a credit limit less than $3,000, USAA issues a USAA Visa Platinum Credit Card with the same terms and fees.
